issues.pattern: Credential Access
issues.explanation: Code accesses credential files (SSH keys, AWS credentials, etc.). This could indicate credential theft attempts.
issues.remediation: Remove references to credential paths. Use environment variables or secrets managers. For docs, use placeholder paths (e.g., /path/to/config). Never load .env or token files in production code paths.
issues.code_snippet:
pnpm i mapbox-gl @turf/turf @types/mapbox-gl
```

The user needs to create a free Mapbox account and create an access token by visiting https://console.mapbox.com/account/access-tokens/.

issues.pattern: Hidden Instructions
issues.explanation: Hidden instructions were detected in comments or invisible text. These could contain malicious directives. Manual review is recommended.
issues.remediation: Audit all comments and invisible characters. Remove any instructions that direct the agent to perform unauthorized actions. Use plain, reviewable content.

issues.pattern: External Transmission
issues.explanation: Data is being sent to an external URL. This could be legitimate telemetry or data exfiltration. Manual review is recommended.
issues.remediation: Verify the destination URL is trusted and necessary. Remove or replace with documented APIs. Ensure no secrets, tokens, or PII are transmitted.

issues.pattern: Unbounded Resource Access
issues.explanation: Skill allows unbounded resource consumption (API calls, storage, compute). Without rate limits or quotas, a compromised or misbehaving agent can cause denial-of-service or cost overruns.
issues.remediation: Set explicit rate limits, timeouts, and resource quotas for API calls, file operations, and compute. Implement circuit breakers for runaway loops.
